bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
COMPOSE="$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
REF=95de18cb9668e117f5804e34c2e3022c61392b8e
W="$P/.worktrees/room-profile-shared-20261114"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || exit 31
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 32
CURRENT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')
PREV=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-shared-4b12b55 --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$CURRENT" = "$PREV" || { echo LIVE_IMAGE_DRIFT_NO_DEPLOY; exit 33; }
CID=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$CID" | grep -c .)" = 1 || exit 34
test "$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$CURRENT" || exit 35
git -C "$P" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/room-application-controls-entry-20261114
test "$(git -C "$P" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$REF" || exit 36
if test ! -d "$W"; then mkdir -p "$P/.worktrees"; git -C "$P" worktree add --detach "$W" "$REF" >/dev/null; fi
test "$(git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$REF" || exit 37
docker build --network host --pull=false -f "$W/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-profile-shared-95de18 "$W" >/tmp/gace-room-profile-shared-build.log 2>&1 || exit 39
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-profile-shared-95de18 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 40
NEXT=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-profile-shared-95de18 --format '{{.Id}}')
test "$CURRENT" != "$NEXT" || exit 41
test "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$CURRENT" || exit 42
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-profile-shared-20261114
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-profile-shared-95de18 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/tmp/gaybbs-room-profile-shared-deploy.log 2>&1; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-profile-shared-20261114 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo GAYBBS_ROOM_PROFILE_SHARED_ROLLBACK
 exit 43
fi
READY=0
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
 sleep 2
 LIVE=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs)
 if test -n "$LIVE" && test "$(docker inspect "$LIVE" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$NEXT" && docker logs --since=90s "$LIVE" 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then READY=1; break; fi
done
if test "$READY" -ne 1; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:backup-before-profile-shared-20261114 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$COMPOSE" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo GAYBBS_ROOM_PROFILE_SHARED_ROLLBACK_NOT_READY
 exit 44
fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 45
echo GAYBBS_ROOM_PROFILE_SHARED_DEPLOY_PASS
echo "SOURCE_SHA=$REF"
